text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /private/tmp/taxkit-posthog-axiom-evidence-20261003.md
+# TaxKit analytics, telemetry and OG research — 3 October 2026
+
+Read-only design evidence. No TaxKit files, packages, providers or credentials were changed. Public npm source archives were inspected in memory; no package was installed. Package metadata: `/private/tmp/taxkit-analytics-telemetry-og-versions-20261003.json`. This is provisional research, not a tested dependency snapshot. Earlier general dependency research remains in `/private/tmp/taxkit-provisional-versions-20261003.json`.
+
+## Common Practice: verified current source
+
+All paths below are under `/Users/cooper/Projects/common-practice/`. These are source observations, not claims about current cloud configuration or delivery.
+
+| Finding | Exact source |
+| --- | --- |
+| Dedicated production-only `daw-analytics` stack; explicit organisation; one production and one shared test/Preview project; exact ownership marker; projects retained | `alchemy.posthog.run.ts:23–47` |
+| Stable project ID/organisation; foreign marker/organisation refused; replacement refused; provider deletion fails; old DAW-to-Common-Practice marker migration is narrowly allowed | `packages/infrastructure/src/posthog/resources.ts:32–128` |
+| Project recovery lists all pages in batches of 100, checks every response, refuses stalled/over-10,000 pagination and duplicate matches | `packages/infrastructure/src/posthog/management.adapter.layer.ts:263–323` |
+| Management key is decoded redacted; only private Distilled credentials constructor sees its string; fixed US management host `https://us.posthog.com` | `packages/infrastructure/src/posthog/management.adapter.layer.ts:91–120` |
+| Public capture key is separate from management credentials; checked enabled/disabled union; US capture host `https://us.i.posthog.com`; deployment stage and project environment must agree | `packages/analytics/src/schemas.ts:4–48` |
+| Development always disabled; ordinary Preview/integration/PR stages disabled by default; explicit `COMMON_PRACTICE_POSTHOG_TEST=true` enables the shared test project; production uses production project | `packages/infrastructure/src/posthog/bindings.egress.ts:18–76` |
+| Browser SDK owns an instance in the existing React Atom runtime; same-origin and Do Not Track checks before import; acquisition has a five-second limit; instance acquired before init; finaliser bounded to two seconds | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/browser.adapter.layer.ts:29–42,85–136` |
+| Browser settings: explicit events only; no auto pageviews/pageleave/clicks/performance/errors/heatmaps/dead clicks/rage clicks/replay/surveys/tours/external downloads/flags; profiles never; explicit DNT; localStorage persistence | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/browser.adapter.layer.ts:135–157` |
+| No consent dialog/choice service; old consent key removed and SDK opt-out cleared without an opt-in event. This is a reference-specific migration, not a reason to add it to fresh TaxKit | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/browser.adapter.layer.ts:109–115,159–163` |
+| Synchronous non-throwing Schema consumer rebuilds allowed envelope/properties and drops other event names; required public token/anonymous ID/UUID/timestamp retained; person processing and geolocation disabled | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/capture.consumer.ts:14–56` |
+| Reference allowed page/actions plus bounded referrer host and campaign labels; no full URL/query/page text/session or person fields leave consumer | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/capture.consumer.ts:14–56` and `packages/analytics/src/schemas.ts:49–69` |
+| Pageview operation suppresses consecutive accepted repeats under one semaphore; remembers after SDK acknowledgement, not before | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/browser.adapter.layer.ts:169–223` |
+| Website relay accepts only enabled deployment, exact `/ingest/e/`, POST, exact own origin and allowed query/media types; full read/delivery has five-second deadline | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/relay/request.ingress.ts:18–86` |
+| Both bodies limited to 1 MiB; only checked body/type/query forwarded to fixed US `/e/`; no caller cookies/auth/IP/referrer/trace headers; outbound tracing disabled; redirects refused; one attempt, no relay retry/fallback | `apps/web/src/lib/analytics/relay/schemas.ts:5–41`, `body.ingress.ts:1–26`, `live.layer.ts:24–83` |
+| Axiom datasets remain owned by Site; Common Practice owns its retained ingest token and dashboards; ingest/create only on logs, traces, metrics datasets | `packages/infrastructure/src/axiom/resources.ts:10–46` |
+| Physical shared dataset names are `site-prod-logs`, `site-prod-traces`, `site-prod-metrics`; reference reads them rather than redeclaring them | `packages/infrastructure/src/axiom/dashboards/types.ts:6–30` |
+| Website explicit OTLP log secret bindings plus Protobuf metrics endpoint/token/dataset; API uses native Cloudflare telemetry and shared metrics layer | `packages/infrastructure/src/axiom/bindings.ts:12–52`, `apps/api/src/deployment/cloudflare/worker.ts:110` |
+| Trace destination is separately retained and project-owned, pointing at shared traces with scoped ingest token; only own Workers opt in | `packages/infrastructure/src/cloudflare/traces.ts:11–44` |
+| Request logs use checked fixed project/stage/worker/route-family/outcome/status/bot labels; no raw path/query/body/header/IP | `packages/infrastructure/src/runtime/request-observation/schemas.ts:55–75`, `event.egress.ts:25–89` |
+| Metrics exporter uses Effect-native OTLP, bounded flushes and export warning checks. HTTP 200 alone is not treated as successful metrics storage | `packages/infrastructure/src/runtime/metrics.ts:54–121` |
+| Private Takumi adapter uses abortable Promise bridge, bundled font, checked PNG output, 1200×630 PNG; apps alone own SDK | `apps/api/src/og/takumi.adapter.layer.ts:1–48` |
+
+The reference is pinned to Effect rc.117, Alchemy beta.79, Distilled PostHog rc.12 and posthog-js 1.435.6 (`package.json:16–32`). Copy the ownership approach; do not copy version claims or patches without rechecking them. Its silent invalid-config downgrade (`Effect.option`) and broad ignored failures in the browser adapter are weaker than the current skill's explicit configured-off/configuration-failure distinction. Fresh TaxKit should keep a named configuration error and an explicit best-effort capture policy.
+
+## Exact latest browser SDK findings
+
+Inspected official [posthog-js 1.435.8 archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/posthog-js/-/posthog-js-1.435.8.tgz), published 2 October 2026. The paths/lines here are inside that archive.
+
+- `lib/src/posthog-core.js:216–221`: default persistence is `localStorage+cookie`, autocapture is on, DNT is **off**, profiles are `identified_only`, IP event property disabled. Set the full minimal policy explicitly; SDK defaults are not TaxKit's policy.
+- `posthog-core.js:353`: default analytics endpoint is `/e/`; `:1621–1623` chooses it for captures. With `api_host:'/ingest'`, the reference relay route is `/ingest/e/`. `/capture` is not this selected browser SDK's default.
+- `posthog-core.js:1599–1607`: `before_send` runs after enrichment, replaces the event, then UUID is normalised. `:4517–4570` supports synchronous return/null and drops callback failures or removed required transport fields. Allowlisted token and anonymous distinct ID must survive. Check the final network payload in qualification, including SDK transport metadata such as `sent_at` added after the consumer (`request.js:482–487`).
+- `posthog-core.js:3370–3426`: `shutdown()` really returns `Promise<void>`; browser timeout argument is ignored; cleanup flushes/unloads pending queues and removes extensions. It is best-effort teardown, not proof of delivery and not a queue-discard/withdrawal operation.
+- `posthog-persistence.js:847–902`: choosing `localStorage` can fall back to `localStorage+cookie` or cookies if storage is unavailable. It cannot justify a claim of no cookies. `persistence:'memory'` directly selects the memory backend; `sessionid.js:145–147` avoids sessionStorage for that setting.
+- [Current types 1.413.0 archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/@posthog/types/-/types-1.413.0.tgz), `dist/posthog-config.d.ts:2106,2172`: `person_profiles:'never'` and `cookieless_mode:'always'|'on_reject'` are supported. Cookieless mode requires enabling the project setting (`:2170`). Browser core marks events for server hash mode (`:1752–1754`), uses a sentinel ID (`:778–782`) and omits a session manager (`:689–691`). It is a different identity design and cannot be added unchanged to the reference consumer/relay, which removes IP/UA forwarding and the cookieless flag.
+- The new SDK also exposes optional browser logs/metrics configuration (`posthog-config.d.ts:1441–1447`). Leave those off; Axiom owns operational telemetry. Keep replay/flags/surveys/tours/conversations/web experiments and external downloads disabled.
+
+Use [official SDK configuration](https://posthog.com/docs/libraries/js/config), [collection controls](https://posthog.com/docs/privacy/data-collection) and the exact archive above as sources. A third-party DeepWiki answer conflicted with the exact source on DNT and `/capture`; it is not evidence for those claims.
+
+## Fresh package candidates
+
+All versions below were read from official npm `dist-tags.latest` on 3 October. Pin exact versions after selection and qualify the resulting fixture. Beta/RC remains beta/RC even when tagged latest.
+
+| Role | Package/version | Official manifest |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Native infrastructure and Secrets/Doppler | Alchemy `2.0.0-beta.80` | https://registry.npmjs.org/alchemy/2.0.0-beta.80 |
+| Effect native HTTP/OTLP/runtime | Effect `4.0.0` stable | https://registry.npmjs.org/effect/4.0.0 |
+| Browser capture | posthog-js `1.435.8` stable | https://registry.npmjs.org/posthog-js/1.435.8 |
+| PostHog management only | @distilled.cloud/posthog `1.0.0-rc.13` | https://registry.npmjs.org/%40distilled.cloud%2Fposthog/1.0.0-rc.13 |
+| Native Alchemy Axiom dependency | @distilled.cloud/axiom `1.0.0-rc.13` | https://registry.npmjs.org/%40distilled.cloud%2Faxiom/1.0.0-rc.13 |
+| OG renderer | takumi-js + @takumi-rs/wasm `2.14.0` stable | https://registry.npmjs.org/takumi-js/2.14.0 ; https://registry.npmjs.org/%40takumi-rs%2Fwasm/2.14.0 |
+| Optional selected font | @fontsource-variable/geist-mono `5.3.0` | https://registry.npmjs.org/%40fontsource-variable%2Fgeist-mono/5.3.0 |
+| Effect diagnostics candidate | @effect/tsgo `0.48.0` | https://registry.npmjs.org/%40effect%2Ftsgo/0.48.0 |
+| Oxlint type checker candidate | oxlint-tsgolint `7.0.2003` | https://registry.npmjs.org/oxlint-tsgolint/7.0.2003 |
+
+Alchemy beta.80 and both Distilled rc.13 packages declare Effect `^4.0.0`. Alchemy already depends exactly on Distilled Axiom rc.13; using `alchemy/Axiom` resources does not require adding another application SDK. Do not import transitive packages directly unless the new source actually needs them.
+
+Effect's own OTLP exporter modules should be the default for this reference pattern. `@effect/opentelemetry` stable 4.0.0 is only necessary if the chosen design integrates an external OpenTelemetry SDK/provider; its peer requirements are in the version JSON. Matching observed current packages, if that design is chosen: `@opentelemetry/api` 1.9.1; core/resources/sdk-metrics/sdk-trace-base/web/node 2.11.0; api-logs/sdk-logs/exporter-logs-otlp-http/exporter-metrics-otlp-proto/exporter-trace-otlp-http 0.222.0; semantic-conventions 1.43.0. Those current versions satisfy the published Effect integration peer ranges. This is metadata compatibility, not runtime proof, and is not a recommendation to add every listed package.
+
+Takumi WASM 2.14.0 has a `./auto` export with a `workerd` entry; takumi-js 2.14.0 pins its WASM/core/helpers to 2.14.0. Helpers permit React 18 or 19. csstype latest 3.2.3 and preact must be considered only where required by the selected exports/peer resolution. Verify native Alchemy bundling, abort, font, image size/cache/timeout and PNG output in the fresh fixture.
+
+Distilled PostHog rc.13 still omits `deleted` from `UpdateDashboardsPartialRequest` (`src/services/dashboards.ts:19763–19798`). Common Practice patches rc.12 to add the actual soft-delete request field. This patch is not automatically unnecessary after the upgrade: if TaxKit manages removable dashboards, qualify a narrowly version-matched fix or wait for an upstream correction. No patch was applied here.
+
+## Recommended TaxKit event contract
+
+This is a proposed contract, not current TaxKit behaviour:
+
+1. `taxkit_page_viewed`: browser owns the event after a successful committed route change. Product field: checked `page` identifier from the authored route catalogue only. An ID such as `calculator-stamp-duty` is safe; the full URL/query/search/form values are not. Suppress duplicate React renders and SSR/hydration emits; A → B → A is three views. No automatic `$pageview`/`$pageleave`/click/replay.
+2. `taxkit_calculator_used`: the common backend calculation service owns the event after a calculation succeeds, regardless of whether browser HTTP, external API, RPC or MCP called it.
